ceiling_statement: FROZEN GUARANTEE. The maximum feasible evolvability guarantee is ratchet-monotonicity over the UNION of committed executable measures AND machine-checked preservation proofs (v1 raised): every admitted evolution step S_n to S_(n+1) carries a certificate that (1) recomputes (never trusts) the committed capability-floor vector Floors(S_n) from the previous release's hash-chained census, (2) proves pointwise measure(S_(n+1), c) >= measure(S_n, c) for every committed executable floor c, AND re-checks a machine-checked preservation/refinement proof for every committed spec'd behavior class B — a proof that S_(n+1) refines or preserves the invariants of B certifies non-regression over the INFINITE behavior class B, not merely its sampled measures, while the admission gate stays decidable because the candidate arrives WITH the proof; (3) proves the union (Floors union ProvenClasses)(S_n) is a subset of (Floors union ProvenClasses)(S_(n+1)) — the certified set itself only grows; (4) fail-closed refuses any step whose floor preservation or proof re-check cannot be established (H3/H7). Monotonicity is unattainable ONLY for capabilities NEITHER measured NOR covered by a preservation proof — that narrowed clause is the honest impossibility.
derivation: Computability, corrected: 'S_(n+1) at least as capable as S_n over ALL semantic capabilities' is undecidable (Rice) as a question about arbitrary candidates — but the v1 inference that a decidable gate therefore exists ONLY for executable measures conflated deciding with proof-checking: a machine-checked refinement/invariant-preservation proof for the step certifies non-regression over an infinite spec'd behavior class, and checking the supplied proof is decidable. Hence the ceiling is the union: executable committed measures PLUS preservation proofs over committed spec'd classes, monotone as a set. Storage/consistency: the floor-and-proof vector must be bound into an append-only hash chain (a floor drop must be a detectable chain break, not an overwritable claim) — else a producer lowers a floor and re-declares it, violating H8. Trade-off limit: unrestricted evolution and guaranteed invariant preservation are jointly unsatisfiable; under H3 the gate sacrifices evolution-liveness, never invariant-safety — every step not provably preserving (by measure or by proof) is blocked.
ceiling_kind: ABSOLUTE (with the widened measures-plus-proofs formula; the impossibility clause narrowed to capabilities neither measured nor proof-covered)
lean_obligation: Model releases as a hash-linked chain R with committed floors Floors : Release -> Finset Cap, measures mu, spec'd classes Classes : Release -> Finset Spec, and proof artifacts pf : Release -> Spec -> Option Proof. Prove: (ratchet) Admit (R n) (R (n+1)) implies Floors and Classes both grow monotonically, mu is pointwise non-decreasing on committed floors, and for every B in Classes (R n), checkProof (R (n+1)) B (pf (R (n+1)) B) = true — preservation over the infinite class B; (decidability) the whole admission predicate is decidable given the candidate's supplied proofs; (fail-closed) non-establishable preservation implies not Admit; (chain-monotone) floors and proven classes never decay across any distance; (tamper-evidence) a lowered floor with valid links contradicts collision resistance of H.

attainment_witness_appendix.candidate_mechanism: B0 witness seats: capability-gate.lisp monotonic ratchet with dataset-stamp; architecture-gate.lisp map-equals-implementation; retired-entrypoint tombstones; drift gates. Steps: serialize the full floor vector (gate list, proof-manifest counts, mutation-kill totals, completion-matrix rows) into the census chained by prev_release_root; admission recomputes S_n floors from the chain and S_(n+1) floors from the candidate tree, compares pointwise, emits an all-or-nothing transition certificate; NEW under v2 — as Lean proofs land, each proof artifact is committed into the census as a ProvenClass entry whose re-check is a blocking admission conjunct, realizing the measures-plus-proofs union.
attainment_witness_appendix.b0_gap_hypothesis: HYPOTHESIS: the ratchet is a family of reactive point-gates, not one global monotonicity theorem — an unmeasured capability has no floor; the floor vector is not bound into the signed release chain (a floor drop is a test failure at best, not a chain break); the ASDF layer graph is not machine-verified (17 .asd files, 3 coexisting version numbers); the kernel monotonic-sequence conjunct is stated but unproved (part of the repo-wide 0/17 proof debt); the ProvenClasses component is empty today.
